note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on the organizational review-board process, synthesizing vocabulary from this course's earlier lessons into a checklist, plus a concrete overview of Salesforce's Health Check tool (score 0-100, risk-tier weighting, custom baselines, published grade bands). No screenshots, per this course's conceptual/architecture policy -- taught through a checklist and a scenario Lab. Health Check's scoring mechanics and grade bands were checked against Trailhead's own Security Basics module and current third-party summaries of the Tooling API's SecurityHealthCheck object before being stated; exact grade-band percentages are given as the commonly documented bands (90%+ excellent, 80-89% very good, 70-79% good) rather than a single invented cutoff.
